summary: This app is maximally conservative: zero experimental, preview, or recently-shipped-unstable APIs. The newest things it touches — effect, toSignal, provideBrowserGlobalErrorListeners, and the Vitest unit-test builder — were all stable over a year before this code was written, and each matches what the Angular CLI generates by default. Risk of framework breaking changes affecting this code is essentially nil.
